description: Cryptstalker Boots Level 60 Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Boots if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Boots, 12 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Boots - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 12 - Arcanite Bar - Nexus Crystal x 3
